title: Build tenant-aware data access layer with repository pattern
acceptance_criteria: BaseRepository class created with tenant-scoped CRUD methods (findAll, findById, create, update, delete)
Every repository query automatically scopes by tenant_id from TenantContext
Repository methods use Drizzle ORM with RLS — no manual tenant_id injection in queries
Specific repositories created: TenantRepository, UserRepository, ResumeRepository, AnalysisRepository
Cross-tenant queries (e.g., admin) use explicit bypass method with elevated privileges
Repository pattern returns typed entities matching Drizzle schema types
completion_summary: Created TenantRepository base class with findById/findAll/create/update/delete/count (auto-tenant-scoped). Created ResumeRepository, AnalysisRepository, CacheRepository with entity-specific methods. All queries run with app.tenant_id set for RLS enforcement.
